slides.title: Ethiopia-Eritrea ties cut: what each side says
Ethiopia's step
slides.body: Closed its Asmara embassy and gave 10 Eritrean diplomats 48 hours to leave, citing "hostility".

slides.title: Eritrea's reply
slides.body: Said it would "reciprocate in kind" and called Ethiopia's claims "astounding".

slides.title: Three weeks on
slides.body: Eritrea's UN envoy said Oct 20 there is no "crisis" and urged respect for its sovereignty.

slides.title: Dialogue, not escalation.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
